geometry.note: Same pot as TendAnimationView.drawPot: rim rounded rect (10,4,100,18,r9); body path M18 20 H102 L92 88 Q91 96 82 96 H38 Q29 96 28 88 Z; light strip M18 20 H34 L42 96 H38 Q29 96 28 88 Z white 14%; shade strip M102 20 H88 L82 96 Q91 96 92 88 Z in shade at 45%; rim shine (16,8,88,5,r2.5) white 35%. Decorations are drawn after the strips, clipped to the body path, before the rim.

decorations.rings: Two bands across the body: rect (18,38,84,7) colors[0], rect (18,52,84,7) colors[0] at 70%.
decorations.drip: Glaze band rect (18,20,84,10) colors[0], plus capsules (width 8, corner 4) hanging from top y 26, centre x and height: x 26 h 12, x 40 h 20, x 54 h 10, x 68 h 22, x 82 h 14, x 94 h 9, all colors[0].
decorations.flower: One flower centred at (60,58): 8 petals, ellipse rx 4.5 ry 9 centred 10 above the flower centre, petal 0 points up, then every 45 degrees clockwise, colors[0]; centre circle r 7 colors[1].
decorations.stripes: Vertical bars width 9 centred at x 22, 42, 62, 82, 102, full body height (y 20 to 100), colors[0], clipped to the body.
decorations.moon: Crescent: the r 15 circle at (56,56) minus the r 13 circle at (63,51), as one closed path, filled colors[0]; nothing is overpainted in body colour. Path: M54.62 41.06 A15 15 0 1 0 69.68 62.15 A13 13 0 0 1 54.62 41.06 Z (the two circle intersections; outer arc on the big circle, inner arc on the small one). Same shape as an even-odd fill of both circles clipped to the r 15 circle, or circle15.subtracting(circle13) on iOS 17; the explicit two-arc path avoids a hairline at the clip edge. Small sparkles x0.55 at (84,42) and (82,78), dots r 2 at (36,40) and (40,80), colors[1].
decorations.flowerBand: Grass band: rect (18,70,84,30) colors[0] with bumps (circles r 5 centred at x 26..98 step 9, y 70). Five tiny flowers centred at x 32,48,64,80,94, y 80: 5 petals, circle r 3 centred 3.5 from the flower centre, petal 0 up then every 72 degrees clockwise; flowers alternate colors[1], colors[2], colors[1]...; centre circle r 2 colors[3].

geometry.coordinates: All x/y for capsules, bars, circles and petals are centres; petal 0 points up, then clockwise. (Capsules and bars give their centre x; capsules hang down from top y 26, bars run the full body height. Rects written (x,y,w,h) are top-left plus size.)
